subheading.default: Find answers to common questions about our roofing services, materials, and process.

default.question: How long does a typical roof installation take?
default.answer: Most residential roof installations can be completed in 1-3 days, depending on the size of your roof, weather conditions, and complexity of the job. Larger commercial projects may take longer. Our team will provide you with a specific timeline during your consultation.

default.question: What types of roofing materials do you offer?
default.answer: We offer a variety of high-quality roofing materials including asphalt shingles, metal roofing, tile, slate, and flat roofing systems. Each material comes with different benefits, aesthetics, and price points. Our experts can help you choose the best option for your specific needs and budget.

default.question: Do you provide warranties on your roofing work?
default.answer: Yes, all our roofing installations come with a comprehensive workmanship warranty. Additionally, the materials we use are covered by manufacturer warranties ranging from 20-50 years depending on the product. We'll explain all warranty details before beginning your project.

default.question: How do I know if I need a roof repair or a complete replacement?
default.answer: Signs you might need roof work include missing or damaged shingles, leaks, water stains on ceilings, excessive granules in gutters, or a roof over 20 years old. Our free inspection service will assess your roof's condition and help you determine whether a repair or replacement is the most cost-effective solution.

default.question: Do you offer financing options for roofing projects?
default.answer: Yes, we understand roof replacements can be a significant investment, which is why we offer flexible financing options with competitive rates to qualified customers. Our team can guide you through the application process and help you find a payment plan that fits your budget.

default.question: Are you licensed and insured?
default.answer: Absolutely. Summit Roofing is fully licensed, bonded, and insured in all areas we operate. We carry comprehensive liability insurance and workers' compensation coverage to protect both our team and your property throughout the project.

ctaSubheading.default: Our roofing experts are here to help you with any specific questions about your project.
